phase: CD-2A — Axis Discretization (first sublayer of CD-2 L2 Sector Observable State Model)
authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04 — 'L2 sector observable-state operationalization' NOT a lifecycle classifier; observation layer states facts, interpretation layer economics; intent words (吸筹/派发/主力) prohibited in observation layer
inputs: CD-1B four-axis table (docs/cd/cd1b_axes_run.json + data/cd/sector_axes/l2_four_axes.json.gz, sha 0f747662efa35818); OK rows only (98,013); INSUFFICIENT_PARTICIPATION/NO_TRADING_MEMBERS rows propagate as INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT — never rescued

development_window.holdout: 2024-01-01..2026-09-30 — ZERO threshold fitting on holdout; holdout bands are pure application of frozen dev thresholds (PIT-clean: at any date in holdout the thresholds were determined strictly from prior data)
development_window.freeze_rule: thresholds frozen once at CD-2A census; moving them later to make states 'look more reasonable' is CONTRACT VIOLATION (Phase J lesson)

RP_axis.variable: rel_eq_mkt (sector equal-weight return minus market equal-weight return, per day)
RP_axis.bands: LOW / MID / HIGH via dev-window quantiles q33/q67 pooled over all (sector,date) OK rows
RP_axis.sensitivity_only: rel_vw_mkt same discretization recorded but NOT used in state generation (declared sensitivity, avoids dual-track freedom)

PARTICIPATION_axis.variable: d_share = vol_share - vol_share_20d (current participation vs its own trailing 20-day level, per sector-day)
PARTICIPATION_axis.bands: FALLING / FLAT / EXPANDING via dev-window quantiles q33/q67 of d_share
PARTICIPATION_axis.note: labels describe trading participation change ONLY; 'capital inflow/outflow' is prohibited phrasing (volume proxy, amount gap declared in CD-1B)

BREADTH_axis.bands: LOW / MID / HIGH via dev-window quantiles q33/q67
BREADTH_axis.sensitivity_only: new_high_frac recorded alongside, not in state generation

CONCENTRATION_axis.variable: ret_contrib_top5 (top5 share of positive return contributions)
CONCENTRATION_axis.bands: LOW / MID / HIGH via dev-window quantiles q33/q67
CONCENTRATION_axis.null_days: ret_contrib_top5 is NULL on no-positive-contribution days (4.1% of OK rows) -> concentration band = NULL, state emission rules handle NULL explicitly (never imputed)

DISPERSION_axis.variable: ret_gap = top5_mean_ret - rest_mean_ret (volume-ranked top5 vs rest)
DISPERSION_axis.bands: LOW / MID / HIGH via dev-window quantiles q33/q67
DISPERSION_axis.null_days: NULL when sector-day has <6 participants (2.6%) -> handled explicitly

per_axis: annual q33/q67 stability across 2021/2022/2023 dev years
census_protocol_support_first.sector_size_stratification: members groups SMALL(5-14)/MID(15-49)/LARGE(>=50) by median participating n; per-axis q33/q67 WITHIN each size stratum; if cross-stratum threshold drift > 0.10 in band probability terms (fraction of MID-band under other stratum's thresholds differs by >10pp), ADOPT SIZE-STRATIFIED THRESHOLDS (structural, frozen per stratum) — else single pooled thresholds
census_protocol_support_first.decision_rule: census decides pooled vs stratified BEFORE any state is computed; the choice and its evidence are recorded in the threshold table; no post-hoc switching

output_contracts.cd2a_threshold_table: docs/cd/cd2a_thresholds.json — per axis: variable, window, pooled q33/q67, stratum q33/q67 (if adopted), drift evidence, freeze timestamp, census sha
output_contracts.cd2a_band_table: data/cd/sector_axes/l2_axis_bands.json.gz — per (sector,date): band per axis + INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT propagation; deterministic dual-run sha check
output_contracts.coverage_report: per-sector band emission counts + NULL counts per axis (concentration/dispersion NULL days explicit)
